paragraphs.source_en: “But if my lord and all his kin were truly uprooted and destroyed, it would be too tragic. When that time comes, I fear Lady Kōdai-in alone will be able to implore the Lord of the Inner府 to spare the Ishida house. It is with that hope that I am going to her. Might that not count as filial devotion?”
